column1: Note: Non-redundant motif-coordinate placements are the primary family-level motif metric. Within each sequence and TF family, predictions with identical 1-based start/end coordinates are collapsed across PWM models and strands; predictions with a different start or end coordinate remain separate. Values represent computational motif compatibility, not experimentally validated TF binding. Counts are family-specific and should not be summed across TF families because different families can overlap the same coordinates. The uncurated 'unknown_or_other' category is omitted.
